metadata.question: Did the land surface in Denmark appear more brown in July 24, 2018 compared to July 19, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 for both dates (July 24, 2018 and July 19, 2017) - Define Denmark's boundary using FAO GAUL dataset - Get images within ±5 days of each target date to ensure data availability 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds since we want to assess actual land surface color - Brown land typically has higher Red reflectance and lower NIR (vegetation is opposite) - Use a "brownness" index: Red/NIR ratio or similar 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection sizes for both years - Check valid pixel counts after cloud masking - Compare brownness metrics: higher ratio = more brown - Valid comparison requires data from both periods ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Denmark geometry const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0'); const denmark = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Denmark')); const geometry = denmark.geometry(); // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get Sentinel-2 data for 2017 const date2017 = ee.Date('2017-07-19'); let col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date2017.advance(-5, 'day'), date2017.advance(5, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); console.log('2017 Images:', size2017); if (size2017 === 0) { console.log('No data for July 2017.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Get Sentinel-2 data for 2018 const date2018 = ee.Date('2018-07-24'); let col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date2018.advance(-5, 'day'), date2018.advance(5, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); console.log('2018 Images:', size2018); if (size2018 === 0) { console.log('No data for July 2018.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Create median composites and calculate brownness index const img2017 = col2017.median().clip(geometry); const img2018 = col2018.median().clip(geometry); // Brownness index: Red/NIR ratio (higher = more brown/less vegetation) const brown2017 = img2017.select('B4').divide(img2017.select('B8')); const brown2018 = img2018.select('B4').divide(img2018.select('B8')); // 6. Check valid pixel counts const count2017 = brown2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); const count2018 = brown2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); console.log('Valid pixels 2017:', count2017); console.log('Valid pixels 2018:', count2018); if (count2017 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Calculate mean brownness for both years const brown2017Mean = brown2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); const brown2018Mean = brown2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B4').getInfo(); console.log('2017 Brownness (Red/NIR):', brown2017Mean.toFixed(4)); console.log('2018 Brownness (Red/NIR):', brown2018Mean.toFixed(4)); // 8. Validation and final answer if (brown2017Mean === null || brown2018Mean === null || isNaN(brown2017Mean) || isNaN(brown2018Mean)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const diff = brown2018Mean - brown2017Mean; console.log('Difference (2018-2017):', diff.toFixed(4)); if (brown2018Mean > brown2017Mean) { console.log('2018 was browner than 2017.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2018 was not browner than 2017.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
